title: ROTARY DODGEBALL
full_story:
The Flora Rotary Club is sponsoring its 1
st
Annual Dodgeball Tournament on March 14
th
in the Conley Gym of the Flora High School.
They are looking to register teams of 10, 8 players and 2 substitutes to play in 3 co-ed divisions.  Age divisions will be 6
th
through 8
th
grade, high school, and 18 and over.  The tournament will start at 9 am and will cost $100 per team, or $10 per person.  Individuals who sign up will be assigned a team.  Sign up is available through a QR code on event flyers and more information is available on the Flora Rotary Facebook page.
General admission to the tournament will be $2 and each admission is registered to win a door prize.
Proceeds will be used for the pickleball courts and Flora Library Park.

title: ZIMMERMAN AT ISF
full_story:
The Illinois State Fair announced that multi-platinum country superstar and Louisville native, Bailey Zimmerman will play the Illinois Lottery Grandstand stage on Ag Day, Friday, August 14
th
, delivering a high-energy performance from one of country music’s most powerful and authentic new voices.
Bailey Zimmerman’s performance at the Illinois State Fair will mark a home-state celebration for an artist whose meteoric rise has captured national and global attention.  Known for his gritty, heartfelt sound and chart-topping hits, Zimmerman has quickly become one of the most impactful stars in modern country music.
“Bailey Zimmerman’s Illinois roots make this announcement especially meaningful,” said Illinois Department of Agriculture Director Jerry Costello II.  “He represents the talent and authenticity that Illinois is known for, and we’re thrilled to welcome him back home to perform at the Illinois State Fair.”

title: BLOOD SHORTAGE
full_story:
There will be an American Red Cross Blood Drive at the Blue Point Baptist Church tomorrow from Noon to 6 pm.  Walk ins are welcome.  Those that donate blood will get a $20 e-gift card to the merchant of their choice.
The American Red Cross says that the severe blood shortage continues, and your donation can help stabilize the blood supply to ensure patient care isn’t at risk.  About 800 blood drives have been canceled since the beginning of the year due to weather, resulting in over 20,000 uncollected blood and platelet donations.  People falling ill with the flu may also be keeping donors away from donation centers, slowing the national effort to rebuild the blood supply.
The Red Cross is asking healthy individuals to book an appointment to give blood or platelets by using the Blood Donor App, visiting RedCrossBlood.org or calling 1-800-RED CROSS.

title: FLORA WOMAN SENTENCED
full_story:
Brittani Workman-Rueger, 34, of Flora was sentenced to five years in prison after pleading guilty in Marion County Court for possession of 15 to 100 grams of a substance containing methamphetamine.
Two Class X charges pending against Workman-Rueger were dropped for methamphetamine trafficking and possession with intent to deliver methamphetamine between 100 and 400 grams.  Another possession of methamphetamine charge for having possession of 100 to 400 grams was also dropped.   All are tied to Workman-Rueger’s arrest on November 16
th
, of 2023.
Workman-Rueger will serve the time concurrently with five-year prison terms handed down earlier in Clay and Effingham Counties.  When getting out of prison, Workman-Rueger will have to complete one year of mandatory supervised release.  She was given credit for 78 days already served in prison.
